'''Brittany''' (Japanese: '''チヒロ''' ''Chihiro'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP243|Same Old Song and Dance]]''.

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} stumbled across Brittany while she was practicing a song-and-dance routine with her twin {{p|Igglybuff}}, [[nickname]]d Gigglybiff and Gigglybuff. {{an|Brock}} recognized Brittany as being the host of a talk show with her name, as well as the singer of the group '''Brittany and the Loony Balloons'''. Brittany invited all of them to her concert later that evening.

At the concert, {{TRT}} appeared and stole the Igglybuff twins, along with {{an|Jigglypuff}}. While Ash and {{an|Misty}} went with Brittany to look for the stolen Pokémon, Brock entertained the crowd with [[Takeshi's Paradise|a song]].

Soon, the Igglybuff twins were returned safely to Brittany, and the concert continued on as planned. Afterwards, Jigglypuff decided to perform using {{m|Sing}} and put everyone to sleep.

|desc='''Gigglybiff''' (Japanese: '''ププラン''' ''Pupuran'') and '''Gigglybuff''' (Japanese: '''ププルン''' ''Pupurun'') are Brittany's twin {{p|Igglybuff}}. They perform with her on stage and are dressed up in many costumes by her. They first appeared when they were training for their performance when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} came along. Brittany made them perform for Ash and his friends and they were very impressed. Suddenly, {{an|Jigglypuff}} appeared and started to bully the two Igglybuff without the group noticing. That evening, the show started and the Igglybuff performed perfectly, but suddenly {{TRT}} appeared. {{TP|James|Weezing}} used {{m|Smokescreen}} and they stole the duo.

Ash, {{an|Misty}} and Brittany chased after them and finally found them. They were able to free the Igglybuff, the duo used Charm before {{AP|Pikachu}} sent them blasting off. In the end, Gigglybiff and Gigglybuff were able to put on another dazzling performance.

Gigglybiff and Gigglybuff's known moves are {{m|Charm}} and {{m|Sweet Kiss}}.}}

==Trivia==
[[File:Janet Unova.png|thumb|250px|Brittany lookalike on the left]]
* Her Japanese name, Chihiro, is a possible reference to idol singer {{wp|Chihiro Yonekura}}, while her English name, Brittany, is a possible reference to the famous pop star {{wp|Britney Spears}}.
* Brittany is somewhat similar to [[Bailey]] in the fact that she had two of the same Pokémon that performed together. Also, both of their pairs of Pokémon have [[nickname]]s that are similar to their partners. (Bailey owns two {{p|Bellossom}} named Belle and Bella. Brittany's {{p|Igglybuff}} are named Gigglybiff and Gigglybuff.) 
* One of the girls seen in the [[Striaton Gym]] in ''[[BW005|Triple Leaders, Team Threats!]]'' has a [[Animated series character recycling|striking resemblance]] to Brittany.
